subject: Add non-fatal unit test assertions (#2223)
reason: The change adds non-fatal assertion macros to the C unit-test framework (src/unit/test_help.h, test_main.c) and documents them in src/unit/README.md. It modifies only test-harness code compiled into the unit-test binary, not the valkey-server or any tool shipped in a build; no command, reply, replication, cluster, or persistence path changes, so no fuzzer scenario can exercise it and none is needed.
